name: @rakko/desktop
description: Rakko 桌面壳：一个窗口 + 一个本地服务

scripts.test: node -e "console.log('desktop: 壳层没有单元测试，用 smoke 验证')"
scripts.bundle:server: esbuild ../../apps/server/dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=build/server.mjs --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.pack:dir: pnpm build && pnpm bundle:server && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --dir
scripts.pack:win: pnpm build && pnpm bundle:server && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win

author: Rakko
